# Hitish Rao P

> Personal portfolio of Hitish Rao P, a software engineer focused on web applications, thoughtful interfaces, reliable systems, and maintainable code.

## Portfolio

- [Home](https://showcase-340.pages.dev/): About Hitish, education, leadership experience, projects, and contact details.

## Projects

- Cursent: AI-native document editor built with MERN, TypeScript, Cloudflare Workers, and a monorepo architecture.
- Nodespec: Freelancing agency built with MERN and TypeScript.
- Instapark: Parking marketplace project built with MERN, TypeScript, GraphQL, microservices, and a monorepo architecture.
- Rolt: Deployment platform inspired by Vercel, using MERN, TypeScript, Kubernetes, Terraform, SQS, and Lambda.
- Quickview: AI YouTube video summarizer built with Next.js, Redis, TypeScript, and Stripe.
- Medblocks: Patient-management system using Next.js, PGLite, TypeScript, and shadcn/ui, with cross-tab synchronization.
